guide.title: The Bluffs Course: Golf in Arcadia, Michigan
guide.intro: Golf Digest's Best in State ranking for Michigan, 2025-'26, places the Bluffs Course at Arcadia Bluffs Golf Club third, labelled "Public" — the highest-ranked course on the Michigan list carrying that label, above #1 Crystal Downs Country Club and #2 Oakland Hills Country Club: South, both Private. Golf Digest's own record for the Bluffs Course (ngfCourseId 18620) also carries 100 Greatest Public #16 and Second 100 Greatest #102. The Bluffs Course sits at 14710 Northwood Highway, Arcadia, Michigan 49613, in Manistee County's Arcadia township; the U.S. Census Bureau's geocoder returns no Incorporated Place for its coordinates, confirmed independently by two separate geocodes — one from Golf Digest's own coordinates for the course, one from the postal address. This guide is about the Bluffs Course specifically, distinct from Arcadia Bluffs' sibling South Course, itself ranked #7 on the same Golf Digest list.

sections.heading: Getting there
sections.body: Michigan's M-22 runs through Arcadia, leading north to Elberta and south to Onekama, according to Wikipedia. Road distances from the Bluffs Course, by OSRM routing: Manistee County Blacker Airport (MBL) is 16.4 miles south; Frankfort Dow Memorial Airport (FKS) is 16.0 miles north; Cherry Capital Airport (TVC) in Traverse City, the practical commercial gateway, is 51.8 miles northeast; Manistee, the county seat, is 20.9 miles south. Arcadia Bluffs offers complimentary transportation to and from local airports for its guests.

sections.heading: The Bluffs Course
sections.body: Arcadia Bluffs Golf Club's own site credits "Course Designer Warren Henderson"; Golf Digest's record for the course credits "Warren Henderson/Rick Smith." Both credits are current and neither source amends the other. The operator's own account of the course's origin: "construction of Arcadia Bluffs began in 1997 and was completed in 1999. The clubhouse opened on July 4th and the golf course to limited play on Labor Day." Golf Digest records the Bluffs Course's year opened as 1999.

sections.heading: Playing the Bluffs Course
sections.body:
Golf Digest lists the Bluffs Course as Daily Fee, not private, and displays it publicly. The operator states: "The Bluffs Course is open to the public seven days a week April through November each year." Both of the operator's own pages agree, live in 2026: the Bluffs Course's stated 2026 operating season is April 1 – November 30. This guide makes no claim about whether the course is open on any specific date; its online tee sheet is a script-driven booking application that could not be read for this guide.

The club's Policies page states, verbatim: "Reservations are required, however, walk-on players will be accommodated when possible. All guests must register in the Golf Shop prior to starting their round." "Reservations may be made within current calendar year. All reservations must be guaranteed with a credit card." "Reservations canceled within 7 days of tee time result in a 100% per player charge (cancellation policy may vary depending on group size)." "The golf course is open to all pre-registered guests and walk-ons when appropriate." "Special Events, both private and public, supersede all reservations." The club's FAQ gives that cancellation clause as a four-tier schedule: 11 players or less, 7 days prior; 12–19 players, 14 days prior; 20–39 players, 30 days prior; 40 or more players, 60 days prior. The Rates page states a different, three-tier version of the same policy: groups under 11 players, 7 days; groups of 12–19 players, 14 days; groups of 20 or more players, 30 days. There is no membership at Arcadia Bluffs: Golf Digest classifies the Bluffs Course as Daily Fee, and the operator's own rate card is a public, per-person schedule with no member tier.

The 2026 Rates page lists peak-season green fees of $285 for eighteen holes, June 1 through October 4, 2026, plus a $75 non-player rider fee, before applicable taxes and fees; shoulder-season rates start at $135 in April 2026.

sections.heading: The South Course
sections.body: Arcadia Bluffs' second publicly accessible course, the South Course, sits at 13637 Northwood Hwy, Bear Lake, Michigan 49614, and books through its own "Book Tee Time" link. Dana Fry and Jason Straka designed it, and it opened in 2018. Golf Digest's Best in State 2025-'26 Michigan list ranks it #7, with a 100 Greatest Public position of #53. Its PGA Head Golf Professional is Dustin Darling and its superintendent is Noah Wiles. The South Course's stated 2026 operating season is April 1 – October 31 — a month shorter than the Bluffs Course's November 30, and the two courses' seasons are not the same. Of its clubhouse dining, the operator states: "The casual full-service concept features carefully crafted comfort cuisine perfect for any occasion. The restaurant is located on the second floor of our stunning South Course clubhouse."

sections.heading: Staying and eating at Arcadia Bluffs
sections.body: Arcadia Bluffs' own lodging descriptions, live in 2026: The Lodge is "located on the second level of the beautiful Nantucket coastal estate-style clubhouse, and accommodates 15 comfortably appointed guest rooms with 1 King bed each and 1 Suite." The Bluffs Lodge "offers 21 comfortable guest rooms with 2 queen beds, as well as a state of the art workout facility." The Cottages are "1900 square foot, four bedroom, four bath cottages." Arcadia Bluffs also operates The Porch at The Dozen, which serves "a full menu of unique sandwiches, burgers, and Dozen Delicacies."

faq.question: How do I book a tee time at the Bluffs Course?
faq.answer: Reservations are required, though the club's Policies page states walk-on players will be accommodated when possible and all guests must register in the Golf Shop prior to starting their round. Reservations may be made within the current calendar year and must be guaranteed with a credit card.

faq.question: What does it cost to play in 2026?
faq.answer: The 2026 Rates page lists peak-season green fees of $285 for eighteen holes, June 1 through October 4, 2026, plus a $75 non-player rider fee, before applicable taxes and fees; shoulder-season rates start at $135 in April 2026.

faq.question: When is the Bluffs Course open in 2026?
faq.answer: Both of the operator's own pages agree, live in 2026: the Bluffs Course's stated 2026 operating season is April 1 – November 30. This guide makes no claim about whether the course is open on any specific date, since its online tee sheet could not be read.

faq.question: What happens if I cancel my tee time?
faq.answer: The club's Policies page states cancellations within 7 days of a tee time result in a 100% per player charge, noting the policy may vary by group size. The FAQ gives a four-tier schedule by group size (7, 14, 30 or 60 days prior), while the Rates page states a different three-tier version of the same policy.

faq.question: Is there a membership requirement to play the Bluffs Course?
faq.answer: No. Golf Digest classifies the Bluffs Course as Daily Fee and not private, and the operator's own rate card is a public, per-person schedule with no member tier.

faq.question: Where is the Bluffs Course?
faq.answer: At 14710 Northwood Highway, Arcadia, Michigan 49613, in Manistee County's Arcadia township. No Incorporated Place is returned for the location by the U.S. Census Bureau's geocoder.

faq.question: Which course should I play next?
faq.answer: Arcadia Bluffs' second publicly accessible course, the South Course, ranked #7 on the same Golf Digest Michigan list, designed by Dana Fry and Jason Straka and opened in 2018. Its 2026 season runs April 1 – October 31, a month shorter than the Bluffs Course's.
